slides.title: Wary of recruitment agencies? We get it.
slides.sub: So we'll let the people who hire with us do the talking. Three hiring managers, in their own words.

slides.quote: I typically refrain from working with agencies as they often provide little value and harass you constantly (sound familiar?) - in Jordan's case this is certainly not true. He has intricate working knowledge of all the top candidates on the market, what they're working on and what motivates them…
slides.name: Michael Brown

slides.quote: Jordan isn't your typical recruiter. He's a strategic partner who actually understands technical hiring and the realities of high-growth delivery. When I'm hiring, he doesn't just send CVs. He identifies the exact culture fit and technical caliber needed to move the needle.
slides.name: Samuel Dare

slides.quote: As a hiring manager he puts the work in to understand your team needs and find the best talent for the job. He consistently delivers results, is first class at keeping you informed and always pushes to get the best deal for everyone.
slides.name: Martin Hansen

slides.title: What a specialist partner should do.
rows: Who the strong candidates are and what motivates them
Technical calibre and culture fit, not keyword matching

slides.title: Hiring in Web3, crypto or AI?
slides.sub: Tell us what you're building and who you need. We'll tell you how we'd find them.
